1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino, de unos 30 cm de longitud, de color plateado, cabeza achatada, boca pequeña, cuerpo ancho, plano, sin escamas, con la aleta dorsal pequeña y triangular; aunque es muy espinoso, su carne es apreciada. Carangidae; Vomer setapinnis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish, approximately 30 cm in length, with a silvery color, flattened head, small mouth, broad and flat body without scales, with a small and triangular dorsal fin; although it is very spiny, its flesh is prized. Family Carangidae; Vomer setapinnis.
